statement: Define postorder(Null) = [] (the empty sequence) and postorder(Node(v, L, R)) = postorder(L) concatenated with postorder(R) concatenated with [v]. Whenever the function returns a result r, the vector r is exactly postorder(root): len(r) = len(postorder(root)), and for every i with 0 <= i < len(r), r[i] is the (i+1)-st element of postorder(root).
preconditions: The finite Tree root satisfies the problem constraints: it contains at most 100 Node constructors, and every stored value v satisfies -100 <= v <= 100.
